observations.text: The prepared worktree was detached at the frozen start commit 0ca98d468bf1a2ac450b9cafab1f6fb2d0572214, with no initial tracked changes; the requested target HEAD is its ancestor.

The Praxis environment supplied repository, issue, branch, commit, and task-path values. The validator's expected-value mismatch map names repository, branch, and commit; issue and path appear only in the non-empty completeness check.
The formal protocol sets max_attempts=2, retry=none, and first_nonpass_stop; the capture code refuses an existing campaign ledger and records per-case claims.

Preparation and offline verification enter zero_step_guard; preparation checks the plant remains at zero steps and time, while verification checks raw traces, authorization, and campaign ledger claims.
The review result JSON parsed and passed schema/target/verdict checks. Commit c95c43a1e448f032d92741baca1344ee72a80ee3 contains exactly the required review.json, and the worktree is clean.

inferences.text: A detached execution with a wrong but non-empty PRAXIS_ISSUE_NUMBER or PRAXIS_TASK_PATH can pass validate_execution_identity when repository, branch, and commit match. This fails the requested exact five-field identity check.

The repository mechanisms for locked source/checkpoint admission, bounded attempts, same-worktree no-retry behavior, and raw-evidence verification are present in the inspected source. No build, test suite, authorization, qualification, capture, or physics run was performed in this review.

conclusions.text: The execution review verdict is VETO because the target HEAD does not establish exact issue-number and task-path binding.
The review task is complete; its only tracked result file is committed.

uncertainty.text: Praxis v2 retention after task exit is external to this repository. The frozen task routes evidence to PRAXIS_EVIDENCE_DIR and requests a campaign-ledger copy, but platform-level post-exit durability was not independently observable in this static review.
